findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：美國加徵鋼鋁關稅並擴大適用範圍，另對多數進口商品課關稅；額外關稅或他國報復可能推高原料（鋁罐）成本，公司若無法轉嫁將影響獲利。
findings.excerpt: After imposing tariffs on steel and aluminum imports, in recent years, the United States has recently increased those tariffs and expanded the scope of their application.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：美國對全球、中國、加拿大、墨西哥等提出或實施關稅，貿易夥伴可能報復，可能擾亂國際市場並推高成本；海外銷售占 41%。
findings.excerpt: The threat, implementation, or modification of new U.S. trade restrictions, as well as any retaliatory measures adopted by affected U.S. trading partners, could prove disruptive to the international market in which we operate and may lead to increased costs of raw materials and finished products.

findings.claim: 管理層稱關稅與鋁價影響屬『溫和』，預期成本至少到 2026 年底續小幅上升，可能再調價；搜尋摘要未見針對 MNST 的中國專屬關稅或出口管制事件。
findings.excerpt: We do not believe, based on our business model, that the current tariffs will have a material impact on the company's operating results.
